Meet Dr. Imran

MBBS • General medical consultations • Patient-centred approach

G.One Care Hospitals provides online medical consultations and in-person OPD appointments. Please share your preferred service and we will discuss availability on WhatsApp before you pay.

Consultations are not an emergency service. For severe chest pain, difficulty breathing, stroke symptoms, major injury or other emergencies, seek immediate emergency care.
